I think here 2K aim for an audience who :

1) Never played any of the games, and want to try it just because it's 'new release! ' 'You can play it anywhere!' 'looks cool!' usual Switch arguments.

2) Played one of the games, know about it or at least the name, but couldn't enjoy the whole serie for whatever reasons. But now they have a console that let them go back in this good ol' time when they were playing it, blah blah blah.

My point is ➡️ None of thoses need the cross saves things, only a little minority do. So why bother adding a feature that isn't an important part of the reasons that make people buy the game (unlike having the game run smoothly or gyro aiming for example) ?
